---
title: "ONC ERDDAP with R"
---

Demonstration of how to use the `rerddap` package to access data from the 
Ocean Networks Canada ERDDAP server. A minimal translation from <https://github.com/oceanhackweek/ohw-tutorials/blob/OHW26/01-Tue/DataAccess/PartI_ERDDAP_Tutorial.ipynb>

Load the packages needed to query the ERDDAP server, wrangle the results, and combine plots.




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(rerddap)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```
:::


Set up the query parameters: how far back in time to pull data, which
variables to request, and which dataset/server to query.

We are pulling the data from this record at China Creek: <https://dap.oceannetworks.ca/erddap/tabledap/scalar_1217325.html>


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
base_url <- 'https://dap.oceannetworks.ca/erddap'
dataset_id <- 'scalar_1217325'

time_series_length <- 14 # in days. note ERDDAP server is slow, which is why we are limiting to 14 days for now.
start_time <- Sys.time() - time_series_length * 24 * 3600
query_vars <- c(
  'time',
  'temperature',
  'oxygen_corrected',
  'oxygen_uncorrected',
  'latitude',
  'longitude',
  'depth'
)
```
:::


Inspect the dataset's metadata (available variables, units, coverage) before
querying it.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
info(dataset_id, url = base_url)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
<ERDDAP(TM) info> scalar_1217325 
 Base URL: https://dap.oceannetworks.ca/erddap 
 Dataset Type: tabledap 
 Variables:  
     depth: 
         Range: 113.0, 113.0 
         Units: m 
     latitude: 
         Range: 49.153883, 49.153883 
         Units: degrees_north 
     longitude: 
         Range: -124.80255, -124.80255 
         Units: degrees_east

         Units: ml/l

         Units: ml/l

         Units: K

         Range: 1.7491443E9, NaN 
         Units: seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z 
     timeseries_id: 
         Range: scalar_1217325
scalar_1217325 
```


:::
:::


Pull the data for the last `time_series_length` days, restricted to the
fields we're interested in. Note the time constraint is passed as a single
unnamed string (`"time>=..."`), as required by `tabledap()`.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
cc_02_data <- tabledap(
  info(dataset_id, url = base_url),
  paste0("time>=", format(start_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")),
  fields = query_vars
)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
info() output passed to x; setting base url to: https://dap.oceannetworks.ca/erddap
```


:::
:::


Plot temperature and corrected oxygen over time, stacked together for
comparison.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
temp_plot <- cc_02_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = temperature)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Temperature at depth ", unique(cc_02_data$depth), "m"),
    x = "Time",
    y = "Temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

oxy_plot <- cc_02_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = oxygen_corrected)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Corrected Oxygen at depth ", unique(cc_02_data$depth), "m"),
    x = "Time",
    y = "Oxygen (µmol/kg)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

temp_plot / oxy_plot
```
